title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. translated_title: SleepXA：组合预训练神经与心脏基础模型用于睡眠表征学习
translated_abstract: 睡眠期间记录的生理信号为神经、心脏、呼吸及其他身体系统提供了同步的视角，同时保留了各模态特有的信息。现有的脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG）基础模型已经捕捉到丰富但各异的生理结构，这启发了一种替代从零开始训练多模态睡眠模型的方法：组合现有的预训练模型。我们提出了SleepXA，这是一个利用同步多导睡眠监测（PSG）数据来组合独立预训练的神经和心脏基础模型的框架。SleepXA将预训练的EEG和ECG编码器与其他PSG模态的轻量级编码器相结合，并通过睡眠引导的对齐来学习共享表征和模态特有表征。我们在来自三个大型队列的9,230条整夜PSG记录上对SleepXA进行预训练，并在涵盖睡眠表征、临床与疾病预测以及日间生理转换的27个下游任务上对其进行评估……
tldr: SleepXA提出了一种通过睡眠引导对齐来组合预训练的EEG与ECG基础模型并辅以轻量级编码器的框架，在三个大型队列共9,230条整夜PSG记录上预训练后，于27个下游任务中验证了其在睡眠表征学习上的优越性。
en_tdlr: SleepXA composes independently pretrained EEG and ECG foundation models with lightweight encoders through sleep-guided alignment, and demonstrates strong performance across 27 downstream tasks after pretraining on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings.
